question: How Does This Photograph Make You Feel?

answers.text: Completely alone, with no one watching. or there's, 100 different eyes on you
I'm curious Because of this head over here, I'm not sure exactly how these cats, ended up in a place where they could find something like this
Like a little bit lonely. It feels like this is the only person in the snow I think that the shadow work here is really great tho
stoic look on their face even the girl in the back she is just standing there
It makes me feel just very aaaa

War Only because of all the rubble The rubble. Oh, in other words, construction No, it's more like, maybe somebody threw a bomb or something. Oh, because of the rubble. Okay. Yeah. That's one way of looking at it.

Honestly, what it makes me think about is like the end of a super late night out. I am a techno DJ So I go out and play it a lot of the time, and by the end of the night, I kind of feel exactly like that. Just like lying down, falling apart, unable to move, but still, like, vibrant and happy that I had a fun night.
cold industrial ish. Modernist. Like, if you've ever been to Saint John, New Brunswick it's like this. It's like... rough.
It's a really urban, and cold at night and a bit mysterious and, like, I feel the speed
I guess it feels like home for me because in my apartment, I have all of these doll heads and broken doll parts, and so... It actually makes me smile because I feel like something resonates.
Yeah he looks like he’s just enjoy his time a his Quest 3
